degree.text: Degree Awarded Bachelor’s Degree in Economics

description.text: Teaching Objectives To turn out highly-qualified professionals armed with a sound basic knowledge of theories and expertise in international economy and trade, familiar with the latest developments in the field of international trade of the modern world, able to handle international business and economic cooperation, and qualified for careers in business, management, research, as well as publicity in economic and trade organizations. Main Courses International Trade Practice, International Trade, International Finance, International Investment, International Marketing, Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, etc. Internship They will be able to handle international business and economic cooperation. Degree Awarded Bachelor’s Degree in Economics Future Career They will be qualified for careers in business, management, research, as well as publicity in economic and trade organizations.

duration.text: The International Economics and Trade at Shenyang University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 2. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper. 5. Sponsorship Certificate You can click here to download the sample

requirements.text: If you are in China now, please register directly in our university; if you want to attend the courses for Bachelor Degree, make sure to have the following: new HSK Band 4，Graduation Certificate and Academic Report from Senior High School; if you are not in China, you can come to China with your L or F visa, then we can help you to complete your formalities after your arrival at our university .
